rename.to: [Inductor][CPU] SIGSEGV in `torch.slice_copy` with large step value

body:
For this case, I think the return values of eager is not correct. Since the C++ kernel has overflow `LONG_MAX` at
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/49e8f9c965118c5b4b0c4727643351e3ca2b7691/aten/src/ATen/native/TensorShape.cpp#L3056 when `step` is `9223372036854775807` and `len` is `426`. Perhaps we should throw an exception explicitly.

issue.title: [Inductor] Avoid tensor slice overflow for large step

issue.body:
Fixes #147071

Currently, if step is a value very close to INT64_MAX, the calculation of slice output length will overflow. This PR tries to fix this problem and thus fix #147071.
